features.description: A real user can register, log in, reload, and enter the dashboard without relying on the demo account.
steps: Create a timestamped test account through the production registration UI.
Log out or use a fresh browser context, then log in with that account through the production login UI.
Verify the dashboard opens, reload keeps the session, and Supabase refresh does not storm.
Verify invalid credentials produce a readable inline error and do not fall back to a fake success state.
features.evidence: Production UI checks after deployments 35a7758 and 588d341 show 3/3 fresh synthetic accounts can complete register -> onboarding -> dashboard -> fresh login -> dashboard/today -> dashboard/practice -> dashboard/review. Code-only deployment dpl_BxFZXXKqCd3FiQRWHhbh7bwovizc keeps the functional path working and removes user_learning_profiles from bad responses. Added npm run smoke:prod:auth-flow as the repeatable production verifier; pre-SQL self-check with one account reported functionalPassed true and dbBootstrapPassed false with remaining users 403 / profiles 409. After user authorization, executed supabase/migrations/20260617153000_auth_profile_bootstrap_rls.sql in the Supabase in-app browser SQL Editor; Supabase returned Success. No rows returned. Post-SQL AUTH_FLOW_ACCOUNTS=3 npm run smoke:prod:auth-flow passed with functionalPassed true, dbBootstrapPassed true, and each account reported db4xx=0 dbFailed=0.
features.notes: Production registration/login and database bootstrap are both passing for fresh synthetic accounts. Do not print test account emails, passwords, or tokens.

Check dashboard route switching for full-screen black surfaces or long skeletons.
Capture desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844 screenshots.
Verify contrast of buttons, cards, form labels, feedback panels, and loading states.
features.evidence: VD-02 changed dark tokens, theme pre-paint versioning, and regression checks. Local learning-flow regression passed 142/142 across desktop 1440x960, mobile 390x844, light/dark/system, route switching, Practice retry/reveal, and listening retry/reveal. Production deployment dpl_vNSef9xouqZ7NS5LdEbHfwe4LZZQ is Ready and aliased to https://www.uuedu.online. Production smoke passed 8/8. features.notes: VD-02 fixes the dark-mode foundation only. Remaining visual/product issues are scheduled for VD-03 Product UI Redesign.

features.description: VocabDaily ships an IELTS-oriented Anki-style card foundation that adds practical study value beyond generic practice screens.
steps: Define a first IELTS card schema with word, meaning, part of speech, collocations, example, Chinese hint, difficulty, and review tags.
Seed a first deck that is useful without external imports.
Wire the deck into existing review/practice flows without breaking FSRS or current word data.
Add tests for card shape, deck availability, and at least one UI entry point.
features.evidence: VD-04 added an original 12-card IELTS Anki-style seed deck in src/data/ieltsAnkiCards.ts, mapped it into WordData and built-in word books, surfaced it on /dashboard/vocabulary, and wired URL wordId entry points into Practice and Review without changing existing FSRS ratings. Focused tests passed for card schema, built-in deck mapping, vocabulary UI entry, Practice URL focus, Review URL focus, and practice runtime focus ordering. Required local gates passed: npm run lint, npm run check:i18n, npm run build, npm test -- --run with 106 test files and 825 tests. LEARNING_FLOW_OUT_DIR=product-audit-2026-06-17/vd-04-learning-flow npm run test:learning-flow-regression passed 160/160 checks and now asserts the vocabulary IELTS Anki section plus practice link. Production deployment dpl_Dd97VG7hdoqTEojyXs2pSFCsEvVm was Ready and aliased to https://www.uuedu.online; npm run smoke:prod passed 8/8; product-audit-2026-06-17/vd-04-production-focused/summary.json passed 4/4 checks for /dashboard/vocabulary across desktop/mobile and light/dark.
features.notes: Content is original and inspectable in source. No external copyrighted deck, new dependency, database migration, auth change, or billing change was introduced.
